basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old enthusiast of Norse paganism living near Roanoke, Virginia. Recently, I've been delving into the lore of Norse mythology and exploring my spiritual path. By day, I work as a graphic designer, which allows me to express my creativity and passion for visual arts. When I'm not working, I enjoy gaming, especially titles with rich storylines and mythical elements. I am single and often spend evenings online, exploring new music and engaging with communities that share my interests. I particularly enjoy the works of Madeon and find solace in the gentle community surrounding Ralsei from Deltarune. The pandemic has made socializing challenging, but I’m eager to connect with others who share my interests.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My knowledge of Norse paganism is mostly self-taught through books, online resources, and discussions on various forums. I have a keen interest in mythology and ancient cultures, which has driven me to learn more about the Norse pantheon and its cultural significance.
